episodes.synopsis: The new transfer student, Luna Ishikawa, is a vampire with a secret: she can't suck blood to save her life!
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire Is Very Bad

episodes.synopsis: Ishikawa's classmate, Eiko Sakuma, stumbles upon her practice session with Otori in the school library.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and Sakuma-san

episodes.synopsis: Ishikawa battles an empty stomach in the middle of a basketball match. Ishikawa looks for a club to join.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and the Sports Tournament / Li'l Miss Vampire and the Club Search

episodes.synopsis: Ishikawa bakes a pound cake for an assignment in class. Otori and Ishikawa go to the mall to eat udon.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and Cooking Class / Li'l Miss Vampire's Day Out

episodes.synopsis: Ishikawa learns more about her classmate, Misa Kusunoki. The students in 2-A celebrate Ishikawa's birthday.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and Kusunoki-san / Li'l Miss Vampire's Birthday

episodes.synopsis: Ishikawa is interviewed by the local newspaper. Ishikawa visits Otori's house to look at his paintings.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire's Interview / Li'l Miss Vampire Visits Otori-kun

episodes.synopsis: With finals over and summer vacation on the horizon, Ishikawa goes shopping for a swimsuit with the girls.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and Swimsuits

episodes.synopsis: Otori, Ishikawa, and the rest of their class go on a day trip to the beach.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and the Beach

episodes.synopsis: Summer vacation has begun, but the whole school is busy getting ready for the upcoming school festival.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and the Start of Summer Vacation

episodes.synopsis: It's time for Kashinokidai High School's annual festival, with food, games, and performances galore!
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and the School Festival

episodes.synopsis: Class 2-A meet up after the school festival at an okonomiyaki restaurant. Ishikawa plans a surprise party.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire and the After-Party / Li'l Miss Vampire's Surprise Plan

episodes.synopsis: Ishikawa throws a birthday party for Otori at her house, with a special surprise present.
episodes.title: Li'l Miss Vampire's Present
